cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID. The 90% national ID coverage in an undated 2025 deck gives no base, so it may be a share of those eligible rather than of the population.
cells.note: A 2025 government deck puts national ID coverage at 90%, which shows a third of the population or more whatever its base. Without a base it does not show two-thirds.
